undated_mentions: Served as staff officer and instructor in the Reichsheer between the wars.
Convicted of war crimes by Soviet and West German courts after WWII; imprisoned in USSR, East Germany and West Germany.
Evacuated the Crimean port of Sevastopol against Hitler's wishes (no date given).
Ordered continued fighting against Red Army and Prague insurgents (no date given).
Arrested in West Germany and convicted of executing deserters; sentenced to four and a half years (no date given).
